about: Known-answer questions for the 54 papers in pduarticles. 'targets' = citekeys that count as a correct paper (any of them); 'key' = a short string the retrieved passage should contain (passage-level check, case-insensitive). Questions are paraphrased so they share few exact words with the paper. type: P = paraphrase, K = names a specific term, N = nothing in the library should match. H = hard, conceptual question with no rare shared words; any listed paper counts as right.
